[SWS_CM_00113] Method to set the value of a field
⌈
The Communication
Management shall provide a Set method as part of the Field class to offer a service
to the applications to request the setting of a new value within the service provider.
ara::core::Future<FieldType> Set(const FieldType& value);

[SWS_CM_00113] Method to set the value of a field
⌈
The Communication Manage-
ment shall provide a Set method as part of the Field class to offer a service to the
applications to request the setting of a new value within the service provider. If the
network binding reported a recoverable communications error in the Set() call, the
error code ComErrc::kNetworkBindingFailure shall be returned in the Future
type.
ara::core::Future<FieldType> Set(const FieldType& value);

Description:
Set a new value of the Field. The method is present only if Field.hasSetter==TRUE,
otherwise it is not present (shall not be generated).
There is no need to have Get method itself return [Application Errors] errors when getting a field
value (as there are no errors possible when getting a field value). The Set-Method may return
[Application Errors], but does so via returning a value different from the one passed in the
request parameter.
